specialistReviews.resolution: Use exact canonical revoke, but retain real PostgreSQL has_function_privilege checks and data role negative tests as release blockers.

challenge.scenario: An authenticated browser calls public.can_read_office_thread_v1 with a different p_user_id.
challenge.finding: The caller could discover another user private thread visibility through definer RPC.
challenge.resolution: Explicitly revoke execute on public parameterized helper from public/anon/authenticated and retain service_role only.

challenge.scenario: A browser RLS policy passes an attacker-chosen author UUID.
challenge.finding: Rows could be seen based on a different participant identity.
challenge.resolution: All select policies use current-user private helper, which binds auth.uid() internally.

challenge.scenario: Anonymous user attempts reading a private thread by guessed tenant and id.
challenge.finding: An RLS policy or RPC default grant could expose a thread title.
challenge.resolution: Policies target authenticated and anon loses private current-user helper/public helper execute.

challenge.scenario: A user calls Office task SELECT with thread_id null.
challenge.finding: Private thread predicate may be skipped without any support membership check.

challenge.scenario: Private participant leaves a thread then requests messages after 0053.
challenge.finding: Read helper might ignore left_at and leak old private messages.
challenge.resolution: Retain 0050 active participant check transitively in private current-user helper; require role tests.

challenge.scenario: A role inherits public EXECUTE despite explicit revoke on authenticated.
challenge.finding: Static tests might report secure despite effective PostgreSQL privilege.
challenge.resolution: Require later pg_catalog has_function_privilege for PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role before release.

challenge.scenario: An Office migration copies only helper function, not all three RLS policies.
challenge.finding: One table continues using unbound old actor helper.
challenge.resolution: Hash-verify canonical entire file including exact drop/recreate policies.

challenge.scenario: The customer baseline is marked ready immediately after 0053.
challenge.finding: Missing advanced tenant subscription guard would be hidden.
challenge.resolution: Stay snapshot-reviewed with old proof null and block actual completion until U10A1 plus full runtime schema proof.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The staged customer baseline 0050-0052 has participant-aware Office RLS but its public actor-parameterized SECURITY DEFINER can_read_office_thread_v1 may be callable by browser users and allow probing another actor thread visibility. The canonical 20260908024000 SQL closes this by exposing only private.current_user_can_read_office_thread_v1 that binds auth.uid(), revoking public parameterized helper from anon/authenticated and binding RLS to the current signed-in user. Append it before advanced Pro-only SQL, no live DB changes.

Public actor-parameterized helper EXECUTE is revoked for public/anon/authenticated and allowed to service_role
